newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: CPC buys 2 unleaded, 1 leaded reformate in tender.
newsitem.headline: CPC buys 2 unleaded, 1 leaded reformate in tender.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) bought by tender a total of two 95-octane unleaded reformate cargoes at $27.40 per barrel and one leaded cargo at above $27.70 cost-and-freight, a CPC official said on Thursday.
CPC awarded one 250,000-barrel unleaded cargo on Wednesday and awarded the other two cargoes on Thursday.
The cargoes are to be delivered in the first half of May to Keelung, Taichung, Kaoshiung or Shalung.
On Wednesday, CPC received offers at $28.40 per barrel for the leaded cargo but did not award the cargo and requested the sellers to better their offer.
